baseline.name: Presence array and complete domain scan
baseline.approach: Mark each value and scan the bounded domain to emit maximal seen runs.

archived.name: Presence flags plus endpoint-parent links
archived.time: Worst O(V) add without rank balancing; O(V) enumeration; O(V) create
archived.space: O(V) flags/parents, output buffers and possible recursive find depth

why: Endpoint links can skip contiguous runs during enumeration, but their traversal/maintenance adds work and does not improve the stated worst-case bounds over this bounded-domain baseline.
quantitative_comparison: Both reserve domain-sized arrays and have an O(V) enumeration bound. The archive adds V parent integers and can traverse a long parent chain on insertion; no proven general improvement is established.
tradeoffs: May reduce some enumeration loop steps after compression, but adds recursive depth, allocations and a fixed 0..10000 domain. An ordered interval map is another baseline with different trade-offs.
evidence_basis: Static comparison against a presence-array baseline on the same value universe; no paired measurements.
